issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) with return type void, but in the solution Pneumatic interface the method is declared to return boolean. The implementing classes in the solution (LaunchedDropdownTower and LaunchedRollerCoaster) implement raisePressure with a void return type, which conflicts with the Pneumatic interface declaration and causes an internal inconsistency/compilation problem. The template Pneumatic.java is empty (intended), but students implementing the interface according to the UML (void) would conflict with the solution's interface (boolean).
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the return type of raisePressure(int) across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution's Pneumatic interface to declare void raisePressure(int pressureIncrease) so it matches the UML in problem_statement.md, and ensure LaunchedDropdownTower and LaunchedRollerCoaster implement void raisePressure(int). Alternatively, if a boolean return was intended, update the UML and the implementing classes to return boolean and adjust the problem statement accordingly.
